justifications.type_expressiveness: Newtypes for AccountId/TransactionId and a typed AccountType enum; LedgerError variants are typed but Unbalanced carries a raw i128 rather than a richer structure.
justifications.error_handling: Typed error enum distinguishes the required failure modes and the library never panics, but uses saturating_add silently instead of detecting overflow as a distinct error.
justifications.api_ergonomics: Sensible derives and a Default impl, but no doc comments on any public item and Display for unknown account uses Debug formatting of the ID.
justifications.idiomaticity: Generally idiomatic with iterator-friendly patterns and proper Display impl, though the sum loop could use .iter().map().sum() and balance recomputation is duplicated rather than derived from transactions.
